text:
Tess Huang: Morning all — quick async for the routing/auth/rate folks. What I did: finished the canary for route-policy v2, traffic split 5/95. Blockers: seeing occasional 429 spikes during long-tail tests. Today: rolling the config to staging with a higher burst window.
Samir Patel: Nice — can you paste the canary config? curious about the burst window value.
Tess Huang: Sure, snippet:
```json
{"route":"/api/v1/generate","policy":"v2","burst_window_ms":5000,"steady_tokens_per_sec":250}
```
Priya Kapoor: 429 spikes — are those coming from token limits or upstream auth latency? I saw auth latency bump yesterday after the token refresh change.
Miguel Santos: I looked at traces — most 429s correlate with a short auth token refresh storm around 03:12 UTC. There were retries piling up. Suggest increasing auth retry backoff to jittered 200-800ms.
Jon Becker: I approved Tess' CR for the canary. Samir, would you be ok with a temporary relax of the steady_tokens to 200 for staging while we monitor?
Samir Patel: Yeah that's fine. Also adding a guard in gateway to drop excessively bursty clients (per-IP token bucket) — I'll open a PR today.
Tess Huang: Thanks, Samir. Blocker for me: need a quick ops hand to re-run the long-tail job after I update the burst window. @Miguel can you kick it once I push?
Miguel Santos: Will do. Ping me when pushed. Also leaving a note in the rollout doc: "monitor auth latencies + 429 rate".
deploy-bot: Deployment tess/canary-route-v2 initiated by Tess Huang — canary id c-8342. See: https://deploys.redwood.internal/c/8342
Priya Kapoor: Quick heads-up — rate-limit rule RL-203 is scheduled for churn this afternoon (it may affect tests). I'll freeze changelists that depend on it until after 18:00 PT.
Tess Huang: Copy that. I'll hold off merging to prod until after your freeze window.
Samir Patel: Small async ask — @Jon can you eyeball the gateway metrics dashboard (latency per route) for the next 2hrs? flag any > p95 200ms.
Jon Becker: On it. I'll post if anything pops.
Tess Huang: Thanks team — will post update when staging long-tail run completes. :thumbsup:
